create_timings_profiler: create a Timings instance to profile code sections with online mean and variance tracking
time_event: call the time method on a Timings object to record elapsed time for a named event
reset_timings: call the reset method on a Timings object to restart the profiling timer
get_means: call the means method on a Timings object to retrieve average elapsed times per event name
get_summary: call the summary method on a Timings object to get a formatted string of all event timings
